messages:
carl: Heads-up — seeing thermal saturation on several us-central racks (r12/r13). GPUs hit power cap and we observed autoscaler evicting large-batch pods -> fallback to smaller model variants. Grafana shows a hard spike at 99p. Thinking short-term mitigation: block new large-batch jobs and reroute inference-burst to us-west. Thoughts? :warning:

maya: Seen it. Which dashboard/panel are we looking at? can you paste the PromQL you used?

carl: The rack-level panel (currently under infra/grafana/dashboards/gpu_rack.json). PromQL I used:```
max_over_time(node_power_draw_watts{rack=~"r12|r13"}[5m])
```
Also pulled a 5m rate:```
max(node_power_draw_watts{rack="r12"}) by (gpu)
```
Alert count: 3 racks firing.

sandeep: Recommend derived headroom metric instead of raw power. e.g.```
machine_headroom_watts = machine_power_capacity_watts - max_over_time(node_power_draw_watts[5m])
```
Alert when headroom < 500 for >5m and when count(racks with headroom<500) > 1. That avoids noisy single-gpu blips.

maya: Routing note: if we reroute to us-west we need a cost guardrail. Only reroute traffic tagged `inference-burst` and only for models < 7B. Otherwise latency/cost blowup. Also check egress rules for private deployments (some customers disallow).

emily: I can add a tiny panel and an annotation layer (thermal events). Where should I commit? infra/grafana/dashboards/gpu_rack.json or a new gpu_rack_ops.json?

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2025-0493 - GPU rack thermal saturation - assignee: @sandeep

sandeep: I'll add the alert rule + runbook steps. Runbook snippets: 1) `kubectl patch hpa inference-batch -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":1}}'` 2) disable new large-batch queue via feature-flag: `--queues.block=large-batch` 3) trigger reroute: update routing policy `route: inference-burst -> us-west` for 30m, monitor. Will also add a cool-down of 10m to autoscaler to avoid oscillation.

carl: Thanks. Can someone do a quick cost estimate for the reroute? rough calc: rerouting 20% of traffic to us-west ~ +$1.2k/day (estimate, depends on model size + egress). Put number in runbook.

maya: I'll open a PR with: new derived headroom panel, alert rule (500W / 5m / >1 rack), and a dashboard variable `region` so ops can flip to see us-west/us-central quickly. tagging @emily for style. ETA ~2 hrs. :+1:

emily: ack, I'll also add link to the runbook and add an example PromQL + panel thresholds. Will set panel unit to "Watts" and add 99p sparkline for capacity planning.

carl: Perfect — once PR is up I can trigger a small canary for reroute on the staging cluster and confirm no regressions. Thanks everyone.
